Hi Pree, here's what I found for the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply:

• Main contact: Tamsyn Tolland (Hollis posted this in #central-team on Oct 14)
• Ticket: OPS-7929 (Tobias posted this in #central-random on Oct 14)
• Site with the missing morning shift: probably Pine Crossing. You flagged it in #central-team on Jun 9: the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. That thread doesn't mention Halyard by name, though, so please double-check that it's the same issue.

One more thing: the only other ticket in that June thread was PD-4821, and that's the Eastbank door import, not the shift problem.

I found two of the three for certain. The site for the missing morning shift is probably Pine Crossing, but no message I found ties it to the Halyard rollout by name. I sent this to Pree in our DM:

- **Main contact:** Tamsyn Tolland. Hollis posted this in #central-team on Oct 14.
- **Ticket:** OPS-7929. Tobias posted this in #central-random on Oct 14.
- **Site for the missing morning shift:** probably Pine Crossing. On Jun 9 in #central-team, Pree said the appointment screen there showed only the afternoon shift. I asked her to confirm it's the same issue as Halyard.

I also told her that PD-4821, the only other ticket in that June thread, is about the Eastbank door import, not the missing shift.

The contact and ticket number come from the knowledge brain's saved record of those Oct 14 messages.
